backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing admin auth, logo storage, AdMob config, and user session tracking with access control checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence linking feature IDs to relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of key frontend files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining theme variables and light/dark mode tokens.
frontend/index.html: SPA entry HTML that bootstraps the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/public/admin/index.html: Alternate SPA entry for deep-linking to /admin, loading the same React app bundle.
frontend/README.md: Project documentation explaining setup, admin flow, features, and production notes for the VPN Time Unlock prototype.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with pathname routing, admin detection, logo rendering, and layout switching between admin and VPN panels.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Handles user authentication state, profile loading, and initial profile setup before showing protected content.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with status handling and query cache reset.
frontend/src/components/RewardedAdStubMo: Simulates a rewarded video ad with timed progress and triggers completion or cancellation callbacks.
Displays VPN session status, unlock flow via rewarded ads, and allows disconnecting active sessions.
frontend/src/config/admob.ts: Exports placeholder AdMob configuration values and settings for rewarded ad simulation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminPanel.ts: Fetches admin status for the current principal and retrieves admin user overview data.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppAdMobConfig.ts: Provides queries and mutations for reading and updating AdMob configuration via the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppLogo.ts: Handles fetching and uploading the application logo through actor-backed queries and mutations.
Provides a mutation to clear VPN sessions and refresh session status data.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state and login/logout helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks to fetch and update the caller's user profile using an actor service.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionStatus.ts: Implements a query hook that retrieves session info, tracks expiration, and computes active/expired state.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnlockSession.ts: Defines a mutation hook to unlock sessions and refresh session status data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page handling admin checks, AdMob config management, and logo uploads with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/timeFormat.ts: Utility to format a seconds value into HH:MM:SS.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, and plugins for the project's styling system.
project_state.json: Defines project state, known admin loading issues, and feature requests for fixing deep-link routing and ensuring the Admin Dashboard renders correctly.
